## Evidence level entering this experiment

## Frozen definition

## Data and integrity
Source, window, sample size, distinct days, unresolved/open outcomes, duplicate/integrity handling.

## Execution economics
Fees, spread/slippage/impact, funding, latency, target notional and whether each value is measured or assumed.

## Statistical plan
Confidence method, clustering/blocking, multiple-testing correction and concentration/drawdown.
